sections.①:
• 브랜드명: Microsoft PowerPoint
  • 한 줄 정체성: 1987년 이후 프레젠테이션 표준 — 슬라이드 단위 시각 자료 제작 도구
  • 공식 디자인 철학: Microsoft 365 / Fluent 2 — 슬라이드는 캔버스, UI는 보조
  • 시그니처 요소 1개: PowerPoint 레드(#B7472A) 헤더 + 16:9 흰 슬라이드 + 좌측 슬라이드 썸네일 패널. Excel·Word와 같은 Office 컬러 코드
sections.②:
• 핵심 키워드 3개: 발표, 시각, 자신감
  • 무드 설명: 중간 회색 작업 캔버스(#525252)에 문서 본래 색을 유지하는 흰 16:9 슬라이드가 떠 있는 발표 메타포. 기본 테마에서는 밝은 리본·슬라이드 탐색기, 다크 테마에서는 어두운 편집기 크롬을 사용하되 슬라이드 디자인은 반전하지 않는다.
  • 비주얼 스타일: 모던 미니멀 (Fluent 2)
  • 밀도(Density): Comfortable
  • 모서리 성향: Sharp (슬라이드 0px, UI 2~4px)
  • 평면성: Layered — 슬라이드에 md 그림자
sections.③:
:root {
  /* Primary - PowerPoint Red */
  --color-primary-50:  #F8E8E4;
  --color-primary-100: #ECC4BA;
  --color-primary-200: #DC9A88;
  --color-primary-300: #CC7158;
  --color-primary-400: #C25A3D;
  --color-primary-500: #B7472A;   /* PowerPoint Red */
  --color-primary-600: #9C3B22;
  --color-primary-700: #7D2F1A;
  --color-primary-800: #5C2213;
  --color-primary-900: #3A150B;

  /* Secondary - 슬라이드 강조 (자유) */
  --color-accent-500: #F2C811;        /* 노란 강조 */

  /* Neutral - Fluent 2 + 슬라이드 패널 다크 */
  --color-neutral-0:    #FFFFFF;
  --color-neutral-50:   #FAFAFA;
  --color-neutral-100:  #F3F2F1;
  --color-neutral-200:  #E1DFDD;
  --color-neutral-300:  #D1D1D1;
  --color-neutral-500:  #A19F9D;
  --color-neutral-600:  #605E5C;
  --color-neutral-700:  #525252;        /* canvas bg */
  --color-neutral-800:  #3B3A39;        /* slide panel bg */
  --color-neutral-900:  #252525;
  --color-neutral-1000: #000000;

  /* Semantic */
  --color-success-bg: #DFF6DD;
  --color-success-fg: #107C10;
  --color-warning-bg: #FFF4CE;
  --color-warning-fg: #8A6900;
  --color-error-bg:   #FDE7E9;
  --color-error-fg:   #A4262C;
  --color-info-bg:    #EFF6FC;
  --color-info-fg:    #0078D4;

  /* Surface */
  --bg-base:      #FFFFFF;          /* 앱 기본 표면 */
  --bg-canvas:    #525252;          /* 슬라이드 외부 */
  --bg-slide:     #FFFFFF;
  --bg-panel:     #F3F2F1;          /* 좌측 슬라이드 썸네일 패널 */
  --bg-ribbon:    #FFFFFF;
  --bg-elevated:  #FFFFFF;          /* 리본·디자이너 패널 */
  --bg-subtle:    #FAFAFA;
  --bg-overlay:   rgba(0,0,0,0.45);

  /* Text */
  --text-primary:    #252525;
  --text-secondary:  #3B3A39;
  --text-tertiary:   #605E5C;
  --text-on-primary: #FFFFFF;
  --text-on-panel:   #252525;
  --text-on-slide:   #252525;       /* 문서 콘텐츠는 앱 테마와 분리 */
  --text-on-slide-muted: #605E5C;
  --text-disabled:   #A19F9D;

  /* Border */
  --border-default: #D1D1D1;
  --border-subtle:  #E1DFDD;
  --border-strong:  #A19F9D;
  --border-focus:   #B7472A;        /* 슬라이드 선택 외곽선 */
}

[data-theme="dark"] {
  --color-primary-500: #CC7158;
  --bg-base:      #1B1A19;
  --bg-canvas:    #141312;
  --bg-slide:     #FFFFFF;
  --bg-panel:     #1B1A19;
  --bg-ribbon:    #1F1F1F;
  --bg-elevated:  #252525;
  --bg-subtle:    #2A2A2A;
  --text-primary:    #F3F2F1;
  --text-secondary:  #D6D4D2;
  --text-tertiary:   #A19F9D;
  --text-on-panel:   #F3F2F1;
  --text-on-slide:   #252525;
  --text-on-slide-muted: #605E5C;
  --text-disabled:   #605E5C;
  --border-default: #484644;
  --border-subtle:  #323130;
  --border-strong:  #605E5C;

sections.④:
• 폰트 페어링:
    • 영문 UI: Aptos → Segoe UI 폴백
    • 슬라이드 본문은 자유 (Calibri / Aptos / Helvetica / Times 등 사용자 선택)
    • 한글 UI: Aptos Korean / Malgun Gothic 폴백
  • 위계 (PowerPoint UI 자체):
    • Title Bar: 12px / 600 / 1.4 / 0
    • Ribbon Tab: 12px / 600 / 1.4 / 0
    • Body Strong: 14px / 600 / 1.55 / 0
    • Body: 13px / 400 / 1.5 / 0
    • Caption: 11px / 600 / 1.4 / 0.02em UPPERCASE
  • 슬라이드 기본 위계 (가이드):
    • Slide Title: 36~44pt / 800 / 1.2 / -0.02em
    • Slide Subtitle: 22pt / 500 / 1.3 / -0.01em
    • Slide Body: 18pt / 400 / 1.5 / 0
    • Slide Caption: 12pt / 600 / 1.4 / 0.02em UPPERCASE
sections.⑦:
--shadow-none: none;
--shadow-slide: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);    /* 캔버스 위 슬라이드 */
--shadow-thumb: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.20);
--shadow-popover: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.14), 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
--shadow-dialog: 0 8px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.14);
sections.⑧:
• 스타일: Fluent UI Icons (Filled)
  • Stroke 굵기: 1.5px equivalent
  • 모서리 처리: Square
  • 추천 라이브러리: Fluent UI Icons
sections.⑨:
Button (Ribbon)

.ribbon-btn { font: 500 11px/1.4 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
              border-radius: 2px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid transparent;
              background: transparent; color: var(--text-primary); cursor: pointer; }
.ribbon-btn:hover { background: var(--bg-subtle); border-color: var(--border-default); }
.btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary-500); color: #fff; padding: 6px 14px; font: 600 12px/1 inherit; border-radius: 2px; border: 0; }
.btn-present { background: var(--color-primary-500); color: #fff; padding: 8px 16px; font: 700 13px/1 inherit; border-radius: 2px; border: 0; }

Slide Container

.slide-canvas { background: var(--bg-canvas); padding: 32px; display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 480px; }
.slide { background: var(--bg-slide); color: var(--text-on-slide); aspect-ratio: 16/9; width: 100%; max-width: 960px; padding: var(--slide-padding); box-shadow: var(--shadow-slide); position: relative; box-sizing: border-box; overflow: hidden; }
.slide.theme-pop::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 8px; background: var(--color-primary-500); }
.slide-thumb { background: var(--bg-slide); aspect-ratio: 16/9; box-shadow: var(--shadow-thumb); border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; position: relative; }
.slide-thumb.active { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary-500); outline-offset: 2px; }
.slide-thumb .num { position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 4px; font: 600 9px/1 inherit; color: var(--text-tertiary); }

Slide Panel (Sidebar)

.panel { background: var(--bg-panel); color: var(--text-on-panel); padding: 8px; width: 180px; min-height: 100vh; overflow-y: auto; }
.panel .head { font: 600 11px/1.4 inherit; color: var(--text-tertiary); padding: 6px 8px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
.panel .thumbs { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.panel .thumbs .item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 18px 1fr; gap: 6px; align-items: center; }
.panel .thumbs .item .n { font: 600 11px/1 inherit; color: var(--text-tertiary); text-align: right; }

Badge / Tag

.tag { padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 2px; font: 600 10px/1.4 inherit; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.tag-saved { background: var(--color-success-bg); color: var(--color-success-fg); }
.tag-anim  { background: var(--color-primary-50); color: var(--color-primary-700); }
.tag-note  { background: var(--color-warning-bg); color: var(--color-warning-fg); }

Navigation (Ribbon Tabs)

.tabs { background: var(--bg-ribbon); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); display: flex; padding: 0 8px; font: 600 12px/1.4 inherit; }
.tabs .tab { padding: 6px 14px; color: var(--text-tertiary); cursor: pointer; }
.tabs .tab.active { background: var(--bg-slide); color: var(--text-primary); border-top: 2px solid var(--color-primary-500); }
sections.⑩:
• 슬라이드 자체 전환은 PowerPoint 내장 효과(밀어내기/페이드/모핑) 사용. UI 모션은 짧게.
--duration-fast: 100ms;
--duration-base: 200ms;
--duration-slow: 350ms;
--ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.33, 0, 0.67, 1);
--ease-morph: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);     /* 모핑 전환 */
sections.⑪: 1. 슬라이드 모서리 라운드 적용 금지 — 발표 메타포 손실 2. 슬라이드 캔버스에 흰색·라이트 배경 사용 금지 — 다크 회색(#525252)이 슬라이드 강조에 필수 3. 슬라이드 내부 폰트 weight 300 이하 사용 금지 — 원거리 시인성 미달 4. 한 슬라이드에 텍스트 7줄 이상 사용 금지 — 7/40 가이드라인 5. 다크 테마에서 슬라이드 콘텐츠까지 자동 반전하지 말 것 — 편집기 크롬과 문서 디자인의 테마는 분리
sections.⑫:
<style>
  body { margin: 0; background: var(--bg-base); color: var(--text-primary); font-family: Aptos, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Malgun Gothic', -apple-system, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.006em; }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  .ppt-demo { max-width: 1180px; min-height: 720px; margin: 0 auto; display: grid; grid-template-rows: 38px 31px 78px minmax(0,1fr) 26px; background: var(--bg-base); overflow: hidden; }

  .ppt-titlebar { background: var(--color-primary-500); color: var(--text-on-primary); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 12px; }
  .ppt-appmark { width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 3px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #B7472A; display: grid; place-items: center; font: 800 14px/1 Aptos, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.22); }
  .ppt-quick { display: flex; gap: 8px; opacity: .82; font-size: 13px; }
  .ppt-file { min-width: 180px; display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 7px; white-space: nowrap; }
  .ppt-file strong { font-weight: 700; }
  .ppt-file small { opacity: .8; }
  .ppt-search { margin: 0 auto; width: min(300px,28vw); height: 25px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.38); border-radius: var(--radius-md,4px); background: rgba(255,255,255,.16); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: rgba(255,255,255,.9); font-size: 11px; }
  .ppt-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
  .ppt-present { background: #FFFFFF; color: #7D2F1A; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md,4px); padding: 6px 11px; font: 700 11px/1 inherit; }
  .ppt-avatar { width: 23px; height: 23px; border-radius: var(--radius-full,9999px); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.65); display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 9px; }

  .ppt-tabs { background: var(--bg-ribbon); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default); display: flex; align-items: end; gap: 2px; padding: 0 10px; font-size: 12px; }
  .ppt-tab { height: 30px; padding: 8px 11px 7px; color: var(--text-tertiary); }
  .ppt-tab.active { color: var(--text-primary); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-primary-500); font-weight: 700; }
  .ppt-collapse { margin-left: auto; padding: 7px; color: var(--text-tertiary); }

  .ppt-ribbon { background: var(--bg-elevated); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default); display: flex; align-items: stretch; padding: 7px 10px 6px; overflow: hidden; }
  .ppt-group { min-width: 86px; padding: 0 10px; border-right: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); grid-template-rows: 1fr 12px; gap: 3px; align-items: center; }
  .ppt-group:first-child { padding-left: 0; }
  .ppt-group:last-child { border-right: 0; }
  .ppt-tool { min-width: 24px; height: 36px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-sm,2px); display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 10px; text-align: center; line-height: 1.1; }
  .ppt-tool:hover { background: var(--bg-subtle); border-color: var(--border-default); }
  .ppt-tool b { font: 800 16px/1 Georgia, serif; }
  .ppt-tool em { font: italic 700 16px/1 Georgia, serif; }
  .ppt-tool .shape { width: 17px; height: 13px; border: 2px solid var(--color-primary-500); transform: rotate(-8deg); }
  .ppt-group-label { grid-column: 1/-1; align-self: end; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 9px; text-align: center; }

  .ppt-editor { min-height: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 158px minmax(360px,1fr) 256px; }
  .ppt-filmstrip { background: var(--bg-panel); color: var(--text-on-panel); border-right: 1px solid var(--border-default); padding: 12px 10px; overflow: auto; }
  .ppt-pane-head { margin: 0 0 11px 22px; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; }
  .ppt-thumb-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 16px 1fr; gap: 7px; align-items: start; margin-bottom: 12px; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 10px; }
  .ppt-thumb-no { padding-top: 4px; text-align: right; }
  .ppt-thumb { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 16/9; background: var(--bg-slide); color: var(--text-on-slide); border: 1px solid var(--border-default); box-shadow: var(--shadow-thumb,0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.2)); overflow: hidden; }
  .ppt-thumb.active { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary-500); outline-offset: 2px; }
  .ppt-thumb .mini-kicker { position: absolute; left: 8px; top: 8px; color: #B7472A; font: 700 5px/1 inherit; letter-spacing: .1em; }
  .ppt-thumb .mini-title { position: absolute; left: 8px; top: 16px; width: 54px; color: #252525; font: 800 8px/1.05 inherit; }
  .ppt-thumb .mini-orb { position: absolute; right: -8px; bottom: -8px; width: 35px; height: 35px; border-radius: 50%; background: #F0C1B4; box-shadow: -12px -8px 0 #B7472A; }
  .ppt-thumb.chart::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 10px; right: 10px; bottom: 10px; height: 26px; background: linear-gradient(90deg,#ECC4BA 0 18%,transparent 18% 24%,#CC7158 24% 48%,transparent 48% 54%,#B7472A 54% 82%,transparent 82%); }
  .ppt-thumb.quote::before { content: '“'; position: absolute; left: 10px; top: 4px; color: #B7472A; font: 800 26px/1 Georgia,serif; }

  .ppt-stage { min-width: 0; display: grid; grid-template-rows: minmax(0,1fr) 34px; background: var(--bg-canvas); }
  .ppt-canvas { min-height: 430px; padding: clamp(24px,4vw,54px); display: grid; place-items: center; }
  .ppt-slide { position: relative; width: 100%; max-width: 720px; aspect-ratio: var(--slide-aspect,16/9); background: var(--bg-slide); color: var(--text-on-slide); box-shadow: var(--shadow-slide,0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.35)); overflow: hidden; padding: clamp(30px,5vw,62px); }
  .ppt-slide::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: -9%; bottom: -22%; width: 38%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: #F3D1C8; }
  .ppt-slide-kicker { position: relative; z-index: 1; color: #B7472A; font-size: clamp(9px,1.2vw,13px); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .14em; }
  .ppt-slide h1 { position: relative; z-index: 1; max-width: 70%; margin: 12px 0 10px; color: var(--text-on-slide); font: 800 clamp(28px,4vw,52px)/1.03 'Aptos Display',Aptos,sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.045em; }
  .ppt-slide-copy { position: relative; z-index: 1; max-width: 54%; color: var(--text-on-slide-muted); font-size: clamp(10px,1.4vw,15px); line-height: 1.5; }
  .ppt-slide-rule { position: relative; z-index: 1; width: 72px; height: 5px; margin-top: 20px; background: #B7472A; }
  .ppt-orb { position: absolute; z-index: 2; right: 7%; bottom: 10%; width: 21%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: #B7472A; box-shadow: -42px -30px 0 #E9A793; }
  .ppt-slide-page { position: absolute; left: 6%; bottom: 6%; color: #7D2F1A; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; }
  .ppt-notes { background: var(--bg-elevated); color: var(--text-tertiary); border-top: 1px solid var(--border-default); padding: 9px 14px; font-size: 11px; }

  .ppt-designer { background: var(--bg-elevated); border-left: 1px solid var(--border-default); padding: 14px; overflow: auto; }
  .ppt-designer-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .ppt-spark { color: var(--color-primary-500); font-size: 16px; }
  .ppt-designer h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; }
  .ppt-designer p { margin: 0 0 12px; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.45; }
  .ppt-ideas { display: grid; gap: 10px; }
  .ppt-idea-card { padding: 7px; background: var(--bg-subtle); border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: var(--radius-md,4px); cursor: pointer; transition: transform var(--duration-base,200ms) var(--ease-out,ease-out),border-color var(--duration-fast,100ms) var(--ease-out,ease-out); }
  .ppt-idea-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: var(--border-focus); }
  .ppt-idea-card.active { border: 2px solid var(--color-primary-500); padding: 6px; }
  .ppt-idea-preview { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 16/9; background: #FFFFFF; color: #252525; overflow: hidden; }
  .ppt-idea-preview.one::before { content: 'NEXT / 2026'; position: absolute; left: 10px; top: 9px; color: #B7472A; font: 800 5px/1 inherit; letter-spacing: .1em; }
  .ppt-idea-preview.one::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: -8px; bottom: -10px; width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 50%; background: #B7472A; box-shadow: -18px -12px 0 #E9A793; }
  .ppt-idea-preview.two { background: linear-gradient(115deg,#7D2F1A 0 48%,#F8E8E4 48%); }
  .ppt-idea-preview.two::after { content: 'IDEAS\\A IN MOTION'; white-space: pre; position: absolute; left: 11px; top: 12px; color: #FFFFFF; font: 800 9px/1.05 inherit; }
  .ppt-idea-preview.three::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 10px; top: 10px; width: 48%; height: 4px; background: #B7472A; box-shadow: 0 9px 0 #ECC4BA,0 18px 0 #E9A793; }
  .ppt-idea-preview.three::after { content: '03'; position: absolute; right: 10px; bottom: 7px; color: #B7472A; font: 800 22px/1 inherit; }
  .ppt-idea-label { display: flex; align-items: center; margin-top: 6px; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; }
  .ppt-idea-label span:last-child { margin-left: auto; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-weight: 400; }

  .ppt-status { background: var(--bg-elevated); border-top: 1px solid var(--border-default); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 0 12px; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 10px; }
  .ppt-status .zoom { margin-left: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }
  .ppt-zoomline { width: 70px; height: 2px; background: var(--border-strong); position: relative; }
  .ppt-zoomline::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 48%; top: -3px; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--text-secondary); }

  @media (max-width: 900px) {
